summary: Join our Central Bank Independence and Accountability Training Course to gain essential skills and insights. Elevate your knowledge and career today
lede: Central bank independence and accountability work involves assessing safeguards and documenting oversight. This course is for professionals in governance, policy, legal, audit and communications roles who need to map accountability and approval channels, review institutional and legal protections, assess governance evidence, and prepare policy briefings and reports for internal and external stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with central bank governance, policy credibility, oversight, and communication.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of central banking functions, monetary policy operations, governance structures, or financial sector oversight. No coding or quantitative programming is required, but you should be comfortable reading policy documents, legal provisions, board papers, and institutional reports. Familiarity with basic governance terminology and internal reporting processes will help you get the most from the exercises.
